mapper.insert: INSERT INTO academies ( name, address, phone, business_number, representative_name, business_start_date, business_cer, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{businessStartDate}, #{businessCer}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT academy_id, name, address, phone, business_cer, created_at, updated_at FROM academies ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT academy_id, name, address, phone, business_cer, created_at, updated_at FROM academies WHERE academy_id = #{academyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE academies SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, business_cer = #{businessCer}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE academy_id = #{academyId}
